AUDIT QUESTION: Batch 77 = the integrator's MERGE AUDIT of branch hardening-redteam (one commit, c1451047) into the release line: LAW L-l (red-team order 2026-11-11 '21:55', B, verbatim from the law file): "A MODEL REPLY COUNTS ONLY WHOLE: a local-model reply feeds a decision only when every field that decision reads is present, of its exact type, inside its enumerated values and ranges; anything else is a failed call (INCONCLUSIVE / unrated / not producible), never a pass, an agreement or a clamped score."
Context: c1451047 was written on a base two days older than today's release line, where story_semantics.py has since gained rate_alone (ruling 60: the moments scorer, which validates with _v_rate and keeps its own fault set ALONE_FAULTS = none / starts_mid_thought / ends_mid_thought / other), the local judge (ruling 87) and the scorer service (ruling 56) as callers. Every caller passes string pids (segment labels such as "clip_01", or the moment id as a string). LocalLLM.chat_json runs the validator on every attempt, retries a bounded number of times, then raises LLMParseError; rate_passages / rate_alone turn LLMParseError into an error, and the scorer fails closed on it (no score, not affirmed). The story-first selector that reads _v_derive / _v_adj / _v_sup / _v_react / _v_label is retired from the live path (law L-q); the live users are the clip scorer (rate_passages on the story path, rate_alone on moments pins) at the pin stage and in stage_validate.
The diff (release line -> the merge): L-l's _field / _str_list and the strict validators; rate_passages validates with the passage ids (every passage rated exactly once, score 1-5 never clamped, a known fault) and keys its output by the caller's pid; verify_support needs same_actor_action_object and presented_as; L-l's own tests (test_editorial_robust and three adjusted suites); and the integrator's resolution: doc conflicts kept whole on both sides (L-l in letter order before L-n; E-FAIL-044; the old R8 line dropped because ruling 93 amended R8), and test_stand_alone_scorer aligned to L-l (its FakeLLM now raises LLMParseError on a failed validation, as LocalLLM does; the prompt-identity test sends a whole reply; a reply that leaves a passage unrated is a failed call, so neither passage is affirmed; that test fails on the pre-L-l file).
Measured: ALONE_FAULTS is a subset of RATE_FAULTS, and the merged _v_rate accepts a valid moments reply. Suites in the merge worktree: test_editorial_robust 30, test_stand_alone_scorer 12, test_stand_alone 16, test_local_judge 15, test_dec13_clusters 6, test_window_review 28, test_caption_entities 6, test_same_event_merge 7, test_question_hook 5, test_trimmed_leading 18, test_edl_rules 100: all pass (skips are worktree-only fixtures).
FIND: a live path (rate_alone, rate_passages, the scorer service, stage_validate, the local judge) that the stricter validators now break for a VALID reply, or that still accepts an incomplete or out-of-range reply as a score; a key or type mismatch between rate_passages' output and its callers; a doc resolution that drops or misplaces a law; a test changed so that it no longer guards what its name says. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.
